content: If this medication is taken in combination with other products that may also cause drowsiness or breathing difficulties, the risk of experiencing serious side effects, such as slow or shallow breathing, severe drowsiness, or dizziness, may increase. It is important to carefully check the labels of all your medications, including over-the-counter products like allergy or cough-and-cold medications, as they may contain ingredients that can cause drowsiness. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is not life-threatening, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Do not share this medication with others, as it has been prescribed specifically for your condition. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug interactions may alter the way your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist.
